macro_bullets: Stocks staged a rebound as Wall Street digested a hawkish Fed rate-hiking cycle, with falling oil helping drive the relief rally.
The Iran war is keeping oil near $100, and Saudi Aramco has halted crude supply to European customers, pressuring fuel, freight and shipping costs.
A veteran strategist warned the AI capex boom risks 'massive capital destruction' in the US, even as chip and memory names rallied.
Putin is targeting Nestlé's Russian business as the Kremlin tightens its grip on Western-owned assets.
Geopolitics stays in focus with Trump set to meet Xi in Washington next week and world leaders convening at the UN General Assembly.
internals_narrative: Memory (+5.3%), Robotics & Hardware (+3.7%) and Semiconductors (+3.5%) led the tape, with INTC (+7.7%), RKLB (+6.5%) and AMD (+6.4%) topping gainers. Communication Services (-1.9%) lagged as TMUS (-5.6%), CMCSA (-3.5%) and CRM (-2.9%) fell.

ticker_notes.INTC: Cramer flagged a 'boatload' of bullish options buying in Intel alongside AI chip call demand after the Fed hike.
ticker_notes.RKLB: Rocket Lab is testing key Neutron hardware as it eyes its best week in over a month.
ticker_notes.AMD: AMD is flashing buy signals in the chip rebound and powering new AI desktop hardware unveiled at IFA 2026.
ticker_notes.SNDK: Sandisk drew heavy bullish options activity called out by Cramer amid the memory-chip surge.
ticker_notes.MU: A SeekingAlpha analyst turned bullish on Micron ahead of earnings, though a growing China threat looms over the memory group.
ticker_notes.ORCL: Oracle rebounded even as analysts questioned its AI capex payback velocity versus Meta.
ticker_notes.MRVL: Marvell agreed with GlobalFoundries on a SiGe technology expansion, deepening its AI infrastructure footprint.
ticker_notes.TMUS: T-Mobile hit a 52-week low as its $85 billion debt load drew scrutiny into the Fed hike.
ticker_notes.CMCSA: Comcast slid amid broad Communication Services weakness and merger jitters weighing on media peers.
ticker_notes.CRM: Six analysts turned bullish on Salesforce as Agentforce renewals sparked talk of a major re-rating.
ticker_notes.VZ: Verizon fell nearly 3% despite recent moves to target faster growth and bigger shareholder returns.
ticker_notes.BA: Boeing tumbled after CEO Ortberg's comments, even as the planemaker landed a record order and won FAA clearance for more 777F sales.
ticker_notes.DOW: Dow said at a Morgan Stanley conference that 7% mortgage rates are weighing on building demand, partly offset by data-center tailwinds.
ticker_notes.T: AT&T was called potentially 13% undervalued following plan price hikes and new perks.
ticker_notes.AZO: AutoZone heads into Q4 earnings with UBS warning of soft aftermarket demand and possible comp miss.
ticker_notes.CL: Colgate-Palmolive declared its regular quarterly dividend amid a premium-push growth case.
ticker_notes.BKR: Baker Hughes won one of America's biggest LNG compression orders.
ticker_notes.AIG: AIG's Jon Hancock is set to retire as Mizuho maintained Neutral and cut its price target to $85.
ticker_notes.ABBV: AbbVie highlighted new real-world data supporting the effectiveness of Vraylar at Psych Congress 2026.
ticker_notes.AMT: American Tower elected Kristen Ludgate to its board and declared its quarterly distribution.
ticker_notes.AEP: Morgan Stanley kept American Electric Power at Overweight while trimming its target to $128.
